name: Optisize – WebP Konwerter
author: Mateusz Krosnowski

sections.description:
Optisize is a powerful yet lightweight WordPress plugin designed to automatically optimize your media library. It hooks into the upload process to ensure every image you add to your site is compressed and converted to WebP, significantly improving page load speeds and SEO performance.

Key Features:
* Automatic WebP Conversion: Automatically converts JPG, JPEG, and PNG uploads to WebP.
* Smart Compression: Maintains high visual quality while drastically reducing file sizes.
* Bulk Optimization: Process your existing media library with a built-in batch processing tool.
* Easy Toggle: Quickly enable or disable optimization directly from the Media Library.
* Content Replacement: Automatically updates post content to point to the new WebP versions of your images.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the optisize folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. The plugin will immediately start optimizing new uploads.
  4. For existing images, go to the Optisize settings page to start a bulk conversion.
sections.faq:
Does it delete original images?

Yes, to save server space, the plugin replaces the original JPG/PNG files with their WebP counterparts.

Can I disable it temporarily?

Yes, there is a toggle in the Media Library to quickly turn the automatic conversion on or off.

Does it support GIFs?

Currently, Optisize supports JPEG and PNG files.
